tag: 百貨週末特賣折扣更正廣播

level.why: 賣場廣播連續更正開始時間與各樓層折扣，需對照圖表與獨白判斷。

script.t: Shoppers at Brookfield Department Store, we have a few updates about this weekend's sale.
script.zh: Brookfield 百貨的顧客請注意，我們有幾項關於本週末特賣的更新。

script.t: First, the sale will begin at nine a.m. on Saturday, not at ten as advertised in the newspaper.
script.zh: 首先，特賣週六上午九點開始，而不是報紙上刊登的十點。

script.t: Please note that the printed schedule lists furniture at forty percent off.
script.zh: 請注意，印刷的時程表上家具是六折。

script.t: Because of high demand, however, the furniture discount has been lowered to thirty percent.
script.zh: 不過，由於需求很高，家具折扣已調降為七折。

script.t: On the other hand, the toy department has increased its discount from twenty-five to forty-five percent.
script.zh: 另一方面，玩具部門的折扣已從七五折提高到五五折。

script.t: Cosmetics and clothing prices remain the same as shown on the schedule.
script.zh: 化妝品與服飾的價格維持與時程表相同。

script.t: Coupons cannot be combined with sale prices, but they can be used on regular-priced items.
script.zh: 優惠券不能與特價疊用，但可用於原價商品。

script.t: Parking will be free for the first three hours, although valet service is unavailable this weekend.
script.zh: 前三小時停車免費，不過本週末不提供代客泊車。

script.t: If you are carrying heavy bags, our staff can hold them at the customer service desk.
script.zh: 如果您提著沉重的袋子，我們的人員可以幫您寄放在客服櫃檯。

script.t: Shoppers who spend over two hundred dollars will receive a free tote bag at the second-floor information counter.
script.zh: 消費超過兩百美元的顧客，可在二樓詢問台領取免費托特包。

script.t: Please remember to keep your proof of purchase in case you need to exchange an item.
script.zh: 請記得保留購買證明，以便需要換貨時使用。

script.t: Thank you for shopping at Brookfield, and enjoy the rest of your day.
script.zh: 感謝您在 Brookfield 購物，祝您有愉快的一天。

q.t: When will the sale begin on Saturday?

choices.why: 正解：九點開始，而不是報紙上的十點。
十點是報紙上刊登的舊時間。
沒有提到中午。
沒有提到週五。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which floor now has the biggest discount?
q.zh: 請看圖表。現在哪一層樓的折扣最大？

choices.why: 正解：玩具折扣提高到 45%，圖表顯示玩具在四樓。
家具原本 40%，現已降到 30%。
服飾維持 30%。
化妝品維持 20%。

q.t: What does the speaker remind shoppers to do?
q.zh: 說話者提醒顧客做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：keep your proof of purchase。

choices.t: Leave their bags at the service desk
choices.zh: 把袋子寄放在客服櫃檯
choices.why: 寄放是店方提供的選擇，不是提醒事項。
托特包是消費滿額的贈品。

choices.zh: 在特價商品上使用優惠券
choices.why: 優惠券不能與特價疊用。

level.why: 電話留言先說原訂內容再更正為替代方案，需推論與理解催促意圖。

script.t: Good evening, Ms. Nguyen, Ravi here at Urban Home, following up on your sofa order.
script.zh: Nguyen 小姐晚安，我是 Urban Home 的 Ravi，來跟進您的沙發訂單。

script.t: When you ordered, I told you the gray sofa would be delivered on Wednesday.
script.zh: 您下單時，我告訴您灰色沙發會在週三送達。

script.t: Unfortunately, I made a mistake, because the gray model is out of stock until next month.
script.zh: 很抱歉，我弄錯了，因為灰色款要到下個月才有貨。

script.t: What we do have is the same sofa in dark blue, which arrived in our stockroom this morning.
script.zh: 我們現有的是同款深藍色，今天早上已到倉庫。

script.t: I can deliver it on Thursday between one and five p.m., and I will waive the twenty-dollar delivery fee.
script.zh: 我可以在週四下午一點到五點之間送達，並免除二十美元運費。

script.t: If you would rather wait for the gray one, I will hold your deposit until it comes in.
script.zh: 如果您寧可等灰色款，我會保留您的訂金，直到到貨。

script.t: Of course, I understand if you have your heart set on gray.
script.zh: 當然，我理解您如果心裡一直想要灰色。

script.t: The blue fabric costs less, so your final price would drop by fifty dollars.
script.zh: 藍色布料比較便宜，所以您的最終價格會減少五十美元。

script.t: Please call me back at 555-0187 before tomorrow at noon to let me know which you prefer.
script.zh: 請在明天中午前回電 555-0187，告訴我您偏好哪一種。

script.t: If I do not hear from you, I will assume you want the blue sofa on Thursday.
script.zh: 如果沒有收到您的回覆，我會當作您要週四送達的藍色沙發。

script.t: Again, I apologize for the confusion, and thank you for your patience.
script.zh: 再次為造成的混淆致歉，並感謝您的耐心。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?

choices.why: 正解：Urban Home，處理沙發訂單與送貨安排。
他只是安排送貨，並非負責開車的人。
沒有提到製造。
他是在處理 Nguyen 小姐的訂單。

q.t: What can be inferred about the gray sofa?
q.zh: 關於灰色沙發可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It will not be available for several weeks.
choices.why: 正解：下個月才有貨，願意等的話會保留訂金。

choices.t: It costs less than the blue sofa.
choices.why: 便宜的是藍色布料。
只說缺貨到下個月，之後會到貨。

choices.t: It will be delivered on Thursday.
choices.why: 週四送的是藍色款。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "If I do not hear from you, I will assume you want the blue sofa on Thursday."?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼說「If I do not hear from you, I will assume you want the blue sofa on Thursday.」？

choices.t: To encourage Ms. Nguyen to reply promptly
choices.zh: 鼓勵 Nguyen 小姐盡快回覆
choices.why: 正解：沒收到回覆就視為選藍色，所以請她及時回電。
沒有要取消訂單。
沒有提到收費。
週三是原本錯誤告知的日期。
